title: texwright document
description: A texwright document tree. Every input format parses into this; it can also be written directly.

affiliation.description: Each author's affiliation, by position in author (null for none)

bibliography.description: Bibliography files (BibTeX .bib or CSL-JSON), relative to the document

numberWithin.description: Section depth prefixed to equation and figure numbers: 0 gives 3, 1 gives 2.3

extra.description: Anything else from front matter, kept for templates and agents

Inline.description: An inline node; `t` names its type

oneOf.description: A line break in the source; rendered as a space

src.description: Path relative to the document, or a URL

alt.description: Alternative text; becomes the caption of a figure

attr.description: Identifier, classes and key-value attributes, as written {#id .class key=value}

oneOf.description: A cross-reference to a label; the text is filled in after numbering

style.description: "auto" prints "Figure 3", "number" prints "3", "eq" prints "(3)", "page" prints the page

locator.description: Page or section locator, e.g. "p. 4" or "ch. 2"

mode.description: "paren" renders [1] or (Doe 2020); "text" renders Doe [1] or Doe (2020); "author" and "year" render one part; "nocite" only adds to the bibliography

oneOf.description: A footnote; its body is block content
